draft_args.prompt: [Look: 1970s ad.] [A driver in aviators chews, blows a huge pink bubble; at 4 s the bubble lifts the whole station wagon an inch off the road; at 8 s it pops and the car lands with a bounce.] Single shot: medium shot, 35mm, eye level, static camera, one continuous 10 s take. Eyelines: everyone looks at the product and each other, never into the lens; faces in profile or three-quarter. Motion carries on through the last half second. [Adults only, no kids. Invented characters; a named real person becomes only their moves and attitude, never their likeness. No gore; bloodstains on clothing are fine, no blood draining out. Nobody looks into the camera. Parody brands only.]
